mechanism: Rizatriptan is a 5-HT1B/1D agonist that may potentiate serotonergic effects, and deutetrabenazine causes CNS depression; combined use increases risk of serotonin syndrome and additive CNS depression.
action: Monitor patients for signs of serotonin syndrome (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, muscle rigidity) and excessive CNS depression; use combination cautiously and consider dose adjustment if needed.
